about.title: Why <accent>cybersecurity</accent>
about.lead: Neither a coincidence nor a trend: a career change built step by step, from technical curiosity to expertise in cloud, network and AI security.
about.p1: Understanding how systems hold together, and why they fail, has always interested me more than any other technical subject. Cybersecurity is the natural extension of that curiosity: it requires thinking like a defender and an attacker at once.
about.p2: After several years in the telecommunications branch of the Belgian Army, I chose to turn that rigour into a civilian skill set: a technical diploma, continuous self-teaching (networks, Linux, TryHackMe), and a deliberate specialisation in cloud, network and AI security.
about.missionText: Understanding systems in depth to defend them better, and proving it with facts, not promises.
about.valueRigueurText: NIS2, CyFun, OWASP, ISO 27001: a method I demonstrate, not merely claim.
about.valueProximiteText: Based in Wallonia, direct and accessible. I do the work myself, from start to finish.
about.valueFranchiseText: Saying what matters, even what is uncomfortable. Never fear-selling.
about.valuePragmatismeText: Priority to impact, not to the superfluous. The best security is the one you actually apply.
